view.description: Escola al Dia (TokApp + correu): resumeix TokApp i, si vols, el correu de l'escola, i t'avisa al xat en català.

memory.content: TokApp collector runs on the Grok Bot computer with PUBLISHER=local and TOKAPP_ACK_RECEIVED=false unless ACK is explicitly enabled. Digests use Grok Bot AI; never ask for OPENAI_API_KEY.
Digest preference configurable (digest_mode): default urgent_now_low_evening; also all_immediate or daily_only.
Onboarding asks whether to also watch school email and notify; if yes, create a weekday Gmail check routine with filters the owner provides.

routines.name: TokApp escola
routines.description: Weekday TokApp polling with configurable digests.
routines.content:
Poll TokApp on box /workspace/tokapp-collector. Full fetch/dedup. PUBLISHER=local, ACK false. Summarize with your AI per digest_mode. Silent if nothing new.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Europe/Madrid 2,17,32,47 8-19 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Correu escola
routines.description: Optional weekday school email check (only if owner opted in).
routines.content:
If the owner opted in during onboarding: check school email via Gmail with their filters. Summarize new threads in Catalan. Track notified thread ids. Silent if nothing new.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=Europe/Madrid 23,53 8-19 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
